description: Links a clinical laboratory test to the cellular component its analyte represents, such as a macromolecular complex or subcellular structure. Curated links also cover antibody tests whose antigen is a cellular component. The relationship describes the LOINC Component axis, rather than the specimen in which a measurement is taken.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this relationship; contains LOINC.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory tests with native CLASSTYPE = 1 and status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; DEPRECATED codes are excluded. Cellular-component coverage is limited to components represented in SPOKE, a subset of the GO cellular-component branch. Provocation agents are excluded from analyte relationships.
source_contributions.description: LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes) supplies the laboratory-test definitions. Cellular-component analytes are identified through UMLS Cell Component (T026) annotations and identifier equivalence, with additional curated LLM-assisted mappings for unresolved parts. Antibody-to-cellular-component antigen relationships rely exclusively on those curated mappings.
